cross_references.relationship: PRIMARY_COMPOUND — CLRA §1770(a)(14) makes warranty non-compliance an unfair/deceptive practice. Always plead CLRA + Song-Beverly together on warranty claims. CLRA adds actual damages + punitive + mandatory fees.
COMPOUND — Rees-Levering governs the finance contract; Song-Beverly governs the warranty. If the finance contract is void (Rees-Levering), the warranty claim is separate and survives. Plead both.
OVERLAY — Song-Beverly violation = UCL unlawful prong. Also UCL fraudulent prong (reasonable consumer deceived by warranty representations). Plead UCL as overlay on Song-Beverly claim.

PARALLEL — If auto finance debt collection follows the Song-Beverly defect, Rosenthal covers collection on the Rees-Levering void contract. Collecting on a warranty-voided or contract-voided vehicle = false representation of legal status.
